verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de publishes its own per-endpoint API reference covering incorporation, notarization, translation, tax and trade registration, plus a machine-readable llms.txt, so a reference to explore does exist. Nothing shows that the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec paths all return 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive 'try it' console, runnable request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
